settings.heavy.label: This machine's heavy gates
settings.heavy.why: A driven session runs these once, at its end, through daoris-driver run-heavy, which runs one repository's heavy gates at a time: a second session's turn waits for the first rather than running beside it. They are kept on this machine and never written into the repository.
settings.heavy.where: Used only where {{repository}}'s own `daoris.gates.json` marks no heavy gate: where it marks some, those are run instead.
settings.heavy.whereMarks: {{repository}}'s own `daoris.gates.json` marks heavy gates ({{names}}), so those are run and this list is not.
settings.heavy.whereNone: {{repository}}'s own `daoris.gates.json` marks no heavy gate, or there is none here, so this list is used.
settings.heavy.whereUnknown: Cannot tell whether {{repository}}'s own `daoris.gates.json` marks heavy gates: {{refusal}}
settings.heavy.summaryUnused: {{summary}} (not used: its own file marks heavy gates)
settings.heavy.workers: Each command may bound its own workers, for example `npm test -- --maxWorkers=2`.
settings.heavy.list: {{repository}}'s heavy gates, in the order they run
settings.heavy.field.name: Name
settings.heavy.saved: {{count}} heavy gate set for {{name}} on this machine.
settings.heavy.saved_other: {{count}} heavy gates set for {{name}} on this machine, run in the order shown.
settings.heavy.cleared: {{name}}'s heavy gates on this machine are cleared.
